name: Gale to Flagstaff — explicit operator criteria
objective: Regional terrain-only rehearsal. Use the explicitly supplied requirement unchanged: slope-distribution Wasserstein-1 distance <= 5 degrees at exactly 500 m comparison support. Treat 5 degrees as an operator-chosen demonstration criterion, not a scientifically validated tolerance. Evaluate real MOLA target terrain and locked NASADEM Earth terrain only; report source resolution, data lineage, search bounds and limitations. No rover experiment, climate/mineral equivalence, global optimality, historical novelty, or physical validation is requested.

target.vertical_datum: MOLA areoid GMM-3 degree/order 50, IAU 2000; radius minus areoid

requirements.label: Mandatory terrain common-support slope distribution threshold
requirements.acceptance_note: Explicit operator-supplied criterion for this local regional terrain rehearsal: compare the slope-distribution Wasserstein-1 distance at exactly 500 m support against 5 degrees. This choice is not a scientifically calibrated universal threshold, a rover validation criterion, or a measured source resolution.

assumptions: The 5 degree Wasserstein-1 limit and 500 m comparison support are explicit operator criteria for a local regional demonstration; they are not evidence of physical or mission validation.
No rover, route, mineral, thermal or weather qualification is claimed.
